items.title: Buzzy Williams Interview, 1980-06-18
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] And yours? Mine is Tony Felici. B-I-L-E-C-I.

ctx.x: You hear from the archive along with Dick Allen.
And yours? Mine is Tony Felici. B-I-L-E-C-I. And I'm Dick Allen. And we all seem to be picking up. So, you can start with the beginning of your life if you want to.

I tell it to start from when you come down here. Is that what you want? Well, I'd like to know how old he is, too. Well, tell them how old you are. You all right? I'm going on 90. I'm going on 90. I'm going on 90. I'm going on 90. That's right. Listen, my mother and father, my father was a concert singer.
